narrative: The narrow account book open at a fresh leaf, the head of the leaf reading 1594, the pen just leaving the first line, frost ferns on the pane beyond the desk.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ruled the leaf, headed it, and wrote the first line from memory.
